## About
Colorado Car Care is a family owned and operated paintless dent repair shop on W. Colfax Ave. in Lakewood. We use special tools to massage the metal from the back side so it returns to its original position, with no fillers and no damage to your paint.
That means no repainting, no color match worries, and a car that keeps its factory finish, which is better for resale. We work with insurance companies, automotive dealers, car auctions, fleets, auto body shops and individuals alike.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 rating from 39 Google reviews, and we'd love to take a look at your car too.

## Services
- Paintless Dent Repair: We remove dents without fillers or damaging the paint, so your car keeps its factory finish. Repairs are quicker and less expensive than conventional repair.
- Hail damage repair: Hail repair using paintless dent repair. One reviewer said their repair is so good you can't even tell what happened.
- Ding repair: Door dings and small dents taken out without repainting and without color match worries.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. We give free estimates on paintless dent repair, including hail damage repair and ding repair. Come by the shop or send us a note through the form.

Q: How does paintless dent repair work?
A: We use special tools to massage the metal from the back side so it returns to its original position. There's no filler and no repainting, so your factory finish stays intact.

Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
